nodes.description: Token name string, mutable via setName.
Token symbol string.
Token decimals, set to 8.
Mapping of address to token balance; mutated by transfer, transferFrom, burn and the constructor.
Nested mapping owner=>spender=>amount; mutated by approve and transferFrom.
Total token supply, initialised to valueFounder in the constructor.
Circuit breaker flag controlling the isRunning modifier.
Constant founder allocation 88888888866666666.
Contract owner address, set to msg.sender in constructor and checked in isOwner.
PWGLToken constructor: sets owner, totalSupply and founder balance.
transfer(address,uint256): moves tokens from msg.sender to _to; guarded by isRunning and validAddress.
transferFrom(address,address,uint256): moves tokens using allowance; guarded by isRunning and validAddress.
approve(address,uint256): sets spender allowance, requires zero-value or zero existing allowance.
stop(): owner-only circuit breaker that halts transfers.
start(): owner-only resume of transfers.
setName(string): owner-only mutation of the token name.
burn(uint256): destroys tokens from msg.sender by crediting 0x0; not guarded by isRunning.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used in every state-changing function.
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= _value unchecked arithmetic decrement in transfer.
balanceOf[_to] += _value unchecked arithmetic increment in transfer.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value unchecked arithmetic decrement in transferFrom.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value unchecked arithmetic decrement in transferFrom.
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= _value unchecked arithmetic decrement in burn.
balanceOf[0x0] += _value unchecked arithmetic increment in burn.
isOwner modifier assert(owner == msg.sender) access-control gate.
validAddress modifier assert(0x0 != msg.sender) access-control gate.

Return flag 'success' of transfer/transferFrom/approve.
